description: surfaceAt measures to the nearest centreline vertex, not the nearest segment
find:
const d = closestOnLoop(track.centerline, x, y).dist;
  if (d <= track.width / 2) return
replace:
const d = Math.min(...track.centerline.map((p) => Math.hypot(p.x - x, p.y - y)));
  if (d <= track.width / 2) return
